announcements.headline: Combined Annual General Meeting of Eutelsat C...
announcements.insight: The tender offer launched in November follows the senior notes offering. Shareholders should monitor the maximum acceptance amount announced later that month.

announcements.headline: Eutelsat S.A.: Announces the Maximum Acceptance Amount in Relation to the Tender Offer to the Qualifying Holders of Its Outstanding €600,000,000 1.500 Per Cent. Senior Notes Due 2028
announcements.insight: Following the November launch of a tender offer, this filing sets the maximum acceptance amount for holders of the €600m senior notes due 2028.

announcements.headline: Eutelsat S.A. Announces the Launch of a Tender Offer
announcements.insight: A tender offer follows the November debt issuance. Shareholders should monitor the outcome of this potential acquisition process.

announcements.headline: Eutelsat Communications S.A. Announces Offering of €400 Million Senior Notes Due 2032 and Launch by Eutelsat S.A. of Offer to Purchase for Cash Its Outstanding Bonds Due 2028
announcements.insight: Eutelsat raises €400m via senior notes while launching a cash offer for its outstanding bonds due 2028. This follows earlier notices of preparatory documents for a combined registration.

announcements.headline: Eutelsat Communications: Notice of Availability of Preparatory Documents for the Combined General Meeting of Shareholders to Be Held on 26 November 2026
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the preparatory documents for the combined general meeting scheduled for 26 November 2026, following the Universal Registration Document release in October.

announcements.headline: Eutelsat Communications: Notice of Availability of the Universal Registration Document for the Year Ending June 30, 2026
announcements.insight: Eutelsat Communications S.A. has published its Universal Registration Document for the year ending June 30, 2026, providing standard annual reporting details to shareholders.
